title: Battery recycling in one paragraph
body: Lithium-ion battery recycling recovers cobalt, nickel and lithium through hydrometallurgical or pyrometallurgical routes. Hydrometallurgy uses aqueous leaching and has lower emissions but more process steps; pyrometallurgy smelts cells and is simpler but loses lithium to slag. Direct recycling, which keeps cathode structure intact, is the emerging third route.
